I was quoted in Sasha Rogelberg's article, ["'Folks are struggling in many cases': GoFundMe's CEO says affordability crisis is behind 40% surge in U.S. fundraisers for essentials like groceries,"](https://fortune.com/2026/11/21/gofundme-fundraisers-for-groceries-essentials-increased-40-percent-american-affordability-crisis/) in *Fortune*, on the growth of crowdfunding for essentials and how gaps in the social safety net drive people to GoFundMe.
